name: GENP
recent: GENP 近期持续进行股份回购，并有多项来自 EPF 与 KWAP 的大股东持股变动申报。公司也按月公布生产数据，并有一项「OTHERS」公告。
notable: 公司于 10 月至 11 月期间多次进行股份回购。
EPF 与 KWAP 多次申报大股东持股变动。
公司公布月度生产数据及季度生产披露。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 的持股变动申报频繁，需留意大股东持股比例变化。

news.title: Bursa Malaysia turns mixed at midday

recent_en: GENP has been actively buying back its own shares recently, alongside multiple substantial shareholder filings from EPF and KWAP. The company also released monthly production figures and an 'OTHERS' announcement.
notable_en: The company carried out multiple share buybacks between October and November.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests.
The company released monthly production figures and a quarterly production disclosure.
risks_en: Frequent substantial shareholder filings from EPF and KWAP warrant attention to changes in major shareholding levels.
